author: New China TV
description: Jining City in China's Shandong is turning compact construction machinery into a big export business. Local manufacturers are tapping into overseas demand for mini excavators and other small-scale equipment, combining cost advantages with product innovation. In the first three quarters of this year, exports of small construction machinery and related products from Jining reached 10.8 billion yuan (about 1.62 billion U.S. dollars), up 39% year on year.
title: China's mini excavators make a big impact in global markets

author: New China TV
description: Foreign ministers from eight regional and European countries met in Istanbul on Friday, opposing military action against Iran and calling for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
title: Regional, European countries warn against new attacks on Iran, call for reopening of Hormuz

description: China has made an important contribution to the global energy transition and carbon emissions reduction, the head of the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) said in an interview with Xinhua. #RenewableEnergy
title: IRENA chief highlights China's contribution to global energy transition, emissions reduction

author: New China TV
description: Voting in the second round of Brazil's 2026 presidential election officially began at 8 a.m. local time (1100 GMT) on Sunday, with polling stations across the nation set to close at 5 p.m. local time.
title: Voting begins in Brazil's presidential runoff

author: New China TV
description: Yemen's Houthi group said Saturday that it had launched seven missile and drone attacks on airports, oil facilities and a military base across Saudi Arabia, as heavy Saudi-led airstrikes hit various Houthi-held areas of Yemen.
title: Houthis claim 7 attacks on Saudi targets as heavy airstrikes hit Yemen

author: New China TV
description:
As grassland fires spread across eastern Mongolia toward the Chinese border from Oct. 9 to 15, some wild animals crossed into China. #Firefighters from China's Inner Mongolia spotted them and guided them safely out of the fire zone.
#Fire #Mongolia #Japan
title: Chinese firefighters help wildlife flee flames at China-Mongolia border

author: New China TV
description:
"Mom and dad, this is Tiananmen Square. I'm here!"
A student from Hotan, China's Xinjiang, shared an emotional moment with his family over a video call as she watched the national flag-raising ceremony on Saturday at Tiananmen Square in Beijing. More than 4,000 km apart, they witnessed the moment together -- connected by a shared dream and love for their country.
#China #Xinjiang #Tiananmen #FlagRaising #Family #Heartwarming
title: 4,000 km apart, Xinjiang students share Tiananmen flag-raising with family

author: New China TV
description: The main structure of the Renhe Grand Bridge in China's Chongqing is now fully connected. Its integrated "noise-reduction tunnel" is designed to shield trains from strong valley winds and reduce noise for nearby residents. #HighSpeedRail #Engineering #China
title: Railway bridge with "noise-reduction tunnel" in China's Chongqing

author: New China TV
description:
40.74 kilometers on water - on a motorcycle!
On Sunday, Zhang Xue, founder of Chinese motorcycle maker ZXMOTO, rode a modified MX450 across open water for 40.74 km, setting a Guinness World Records title for the greatest distance driven over open water by a modified motorcycle.
#ZhangXue #ZXMOTO #GuinnessWorldRecords #Motorcycle #Innovation
title: China's Zhang Xue sets new Guinness World Record with motorcycle on water

author: New China TV
description:
A safety lesson, a little fun — and a sweet thank-you.
At a temporary shelter in quake-hit Baqen County, China's Xizang, firefighters are teaching residents how to escape safely and use firefighting equipment. They also brought fire-safety toys for children, turning the lesson into a fun, interactive experience.
#Xizang #EarthquakeRelief #Firefighters #China
title: Firefighters' special safety class after the quake

author: New China TV
description: A palm-sized test kit developed by Southwest University in Chongqing can detect six potato viruses in just five minutes. Now used in China and more than 10 Belt and Road partner countries, the innovation is helping farmers protect crops and strengthen global food security. #Agriculture #Innovation #FoodSecurity
title: 5-minute test helps protect potato crops in China and beyond

author: New China TV
description:
A major fire devastated Adolf #Hitler's former mountaintop retreat in Bavaria, southern Germany, on Friday night.
Known as the Eagle's Nest, the building had operated as a cafe and restaurant since 1952.
Its official website now says it is closed until further notice. #EaglesNest
title: Fire devastates Hitler's mountain retreat in southern Germany

author: New China TV
description:
After a 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck neighboring Baqen County in China's Xizang, teachers at a boarding school in Qinghai evacuated 120 students in about three minutes.
#Earthquake #China #Rescue #Teachers

description:
Golden rice fields, emerald waters and giant ships - autumn brings a stunning new view to China's Pinglu Canal.

title: China's Pinglu Canal meets its first autumn

description:
Rescue and relief efforts continue after a 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck Baqen County in China's Xizang. At more than 4,800 meters above sea level, rescuers are working in thin air and bitter cold.

#Xizang #EarthquakeRelief #RescueAndRelief #ChinaNews

author: New China TV
description:
Ever dreamed of floating in the sky? 
At Pingshan Canyon in Hubei Province, central China, crystal-clear emerald waters create the illusion of boats suspended in midair. At Wuchimen, towering cliffs close in to form a dramatic passage just 1.6 meters wide, where sunlight dances on the water and nature puts on a breathtaking show. 
No filters, just the magic of Pingshan.
#ChinaTravel #DiscoverChina #PingshanCanyon
title: A hidden gem in China where boats seem to float on air
